phase_evolution.value: During intercritical annealing, portions of bainite and martensite reaustenitize due to the high solubility of carbon in austenite; carbon-depleted regions form ferrite, some carbon-enriched austenite is retained during cooling as RA, unstabilized austenite transforms to fresh martensite, and bainite forms during cooling in regions not fully austenitized.
